events.verdict: Towns (NYK) jumps vertically and does not deliver contact as LeVert (CLE) jumps to make the pass.
Garland (CLE) makes clean contact with the ball to dislodge it from Brunson's (NYK) possession.
Garland (CLE) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
Brunson (NYK) establishes himself in a screening position in Garland's (NYK) path and Garland dislodges him from his legally obtained position.
Towns (NYK) initiates contact across Allen's (CLE) right arm, affecting his shot attempt near the rim.
Garland (CLE) briefly grasps Brunson's (NYK) jersey but the contact is incidental to Garland's effort to block the shot attempt.
Allen (CLE) grabs and holds Towns' (NYK) arm, affecting his ability to move freely. The illegal contact between the two players is first initiated by Allen before any contact from Towns.
Brunson (NYK) and Mobley (CLE) come together away from the ball and the contact between the two players is marginal.
Allen (CLE) jumps vertically and absorbs the marginal contact created by Anunoby (NYK) during his driving shot attempt.
Brunson (NYK) briefly grasps Mobley's (CLE) arm and the contact is marginal.
Brunson (NYK) crowds Mobley's (CLE) space and is not dislodged from his defensive position by any illegal contact from Mobley.
Brunson (NYK) lowers his hand down across Mobley's (CLE) arm, but a timeout is granted to Cleveland before any possible foul can be assessed.

Cleveland signals for timeout prior to Brunson (NYK) dislodging the ball from Mobley (CLE) and the timeout request is granted. After the ball is dislodged and the timeout is granted, Mobley lowers his arms as a result of the loose ball and there is incidental contact with Brunson's face.  Contact to an opponent's head/face can be deemed incidental when the result of a natural basketball move, provided the contact is not disproportionate or uncontrolled.
Anunoby (NYK) reaches across Garland's (CLE) left arm and initiates illegal contact in order to get to the ball.
Mitchell (CLE) steps on Anunoby's (NYK) foot when he is in a legal guarding position and the incidental contact causes Anunoby to lose his balance.
Bridges (NYK) commits a take foul on Wade (CLE).
Allen (CLE) contests the jump shot attempt by Brunson (NYK) and avoids making any illegal contact.
Bridges (NYK) is out of bounds when he makes contact with the ball and possession should be awarded to Cleveland.
Mobley (CLE) grazes Anunoby's (NYK) off-arm contesting his layup attempt.
McBride (NYK) commits a take foul on Mitchell (CLE).
Towns (NYK) commits a take foul on Mitchell (CLE).
